retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast portrait layout featuring a vertical split between black and white backgrounds with color-inverted subject halves and bold, condensed red typography.
excludeWhen: horizontal text alignment is the only option

recipe.visualDefinition: A centered male portrait bisected vertically; the left side is a high-key white-on-black negative image, while the right side is a standard grayscale-on-white positive image. Bold, condensed red sans-serif type is arranged in a L-shape around the subject.
coreVisualRelationships: Vertical bisection of the subject and background
Inversion of tonal values across the central axis
High-contrast grayscale subject against a primary red accent color
coreInvariants: The vertical split must align with the center of the subject's face.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centered, medium close-up portrait from the waist up.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central vertical line dividing the two tonal halves.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the top-right text, moves down the vertical text, across the bottom text, and up the central split.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Balanced between the solid black left background and solid white right background.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast with zero saturation in the image, paired with high saturation in the text.

composition.position: top right, bottom center, and vertical right
composition.relationshipToImage: Text sits on top of the subject, crossing the central split.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface used in multiple orientations (horizontal and vertical).

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, condensed, and bold presence.
Provides the necessary verticality and clean sans-serif lines.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a portrait of a subject bisected vertically. The left half should be a high-contrast negative (white highlights on black background) and the right half should be a standard grayscale positive (black shadows on white background).
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add bold, extra-condensed red sans-serif text in all caps. Place one word at the top right, one word oriented vertically along the right edge, and two words at the bottom, spanning across the central split.

verificationChecks: Is the central split perfectly vertical?
Is the text a vibrant, solid red?
Is the left side of the subject a tonal negative?
Is the font extra-condensed and bold?

mustRedesign: Any logos or specific brand names
The specific face of the individual

mustAchieve: Sharp tonal transition at the center
avoid: Soft gradients between the black and white backgrounds

postGenerationChecks: Verify the vertical text is rotated 90 degrees clockwise.
Ensure the red text remains legible over both black and white backgrounds.
Check that the subject's features align perfectly across the split.
Confirm the absence of any color other than black, white, and red.
recipe.reuseFormula: Apply a vertical tonal inversion filter to a centered portrait and frame with L-shaped condensed red typography.
